events.name: End of Watch Locker Scene
events.description: You're the cop filming yourself in the locker room: a grin into the camera with your partner leaning in, then your gear held up to the lens one piece at a time.

events.name: Pick It Up Dance
events.description: Two friends dance the Pick It Up routine side by side in a bright unfinished office corridor, filmed on a fixed phone: hands locked over the head, a turn to show their backs and bounce, a turn back round with arms out, and a wide low squat to finish.
